purpose: precommit how an all-24 exact reverse-peeling run will be interpreted if and only if the already-frozen one-history smoke passes
launch_precondition: the one-history reverse-peeling smoke must have smoke_pass_all=true under its frozen protocol; otherwise the all-24 run is prohibited
all24_primary_support_requires_all: true last-stage inverse converges for all 24 histories
full chronology recovery is at least 18/24
full chronology recovery is strictly greater than frozen direct K3 3/24
full chronology recovery is strictly greater than frozen recency 1/24
K3-wrong to peeling-correct repairs strictly exceed K3-correct to peeling-wrong regressions
at least 18/24 histories select the true last stage with positive residual margin

interpretation_tiers.strong: all primary support conditions pass; proceed to polynomial relaxed peeling on spent data before any confirmation codebook
interpretation_tiers.promising_not_strong: full chronology is 12-17/24 with positive net repairs; continue only on spent data and diagnose failure strata
interpretation_tiers.weak: full chronology is 4-11/24; reverse peeling improves on K3 but is not reliable enough for confirmation
interpretation_tiers.fail: full chronology is at most 3/24, true-stage inversion is unstable, or net repairs are non-positive; abandon or redesign exact peeling

anti_tuning_rules: do not change inverse tolerance, maximum iterations, learning rate, precision, stage seeds, target histories, residual definition, or predecessor decoder after observing smoke output
do not use held-out confirmation codebooks for debugging or threshold selection
do not promote a promising_not_strong result to primary support by adding post-hoc strata
do not claim scalable reconstruction from exact all-24 enumeration even if strong
next_step_if_strong: implement and test a polynomial-size K3 local-order convex relaxation on the same spent codebook, then compare relaxed candidate-last elimination against exact peeling
next_step_if_not_strong: remain on the spent codebook and diagnose inversion versus reachable-set failures; do not launch confirmation
